plugin.name: YouTubeMusic
plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Fix prefetch stopping too early on albums (was stopping at 3 tracks remaining). Add "Disable persistent Node worker" option in settings for memory-constrained systems like Pi Zero 2W (~140MB RAM saving). Update piCorePlayer log path suggestion. Thanks to Paul Webster.
